title: Concept of time
quote: 1° = 4 minutes; 15° = 1 hour; east is ahead (add), west is behind (subtract)

boxes.title: Solving local time
steps: Longitude gap: same side subtract, opposite sides **add**
Add if east, subtract if west

boxes.title: Time terms
head: Term
Meaning
rows: Kept by ==**caesium** atomic clocks==; leap seconds
Clocks +**1 hour** in summer; **India does not use**

boxes.title: Indian Standard Time
items: **5 states**: UP, MP, Chhattisgarh, Odisha, **AP** (Kakinada); ⚠ **not West Bengal** (APPSC 2021)
Meets Tropic of Cancer in **Chhattisgarh** (Koriya district)
Span **68°7'E - 97°25'E** ≈ **29°** → ~**2 hours** gap Arunachal vs Gujarat

boxes.title: International Date Line
items: Zigzags around Chukotka, Aleutians, Kiribati, Fiji, Tonga, Samoa
Big Diomede (Russia) vs Little Diomede (USA): different dates; **Samoa** shifted **2011**

items.what: ==**Summer solstice**==: Sun over **Tropic of Cancer**; NH longest day

boxes.title: Tropic of Cancer & tilt
items: Crosses ==**8 states**== (APPSC 2025): Gujarat, Rajasthan, MP, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, WB, Tripura, Mizoram
Tilt **23½°** from perpendicular = **66½°** to orbital plane
Axis **parallelism** → opposite seasons in two hemispheres

items.what: **White Rabbit** network, **Jakkur** (Bengaluru): GPS-free sync; protocol by **CERN**
==**Legal Metrology (IST) Rules, 2026**==: IST single legal reference
